evidence.text: How do horizon quantum corrections, bulk energy fluctuations, and black-hole acceleration modify entanglement measures, and what conditional information do these modifications provide about quantum gravity?

sources.title: The Trouble with de Sitter space

evidence.text: Can an isolated de Sitter causal patch with finite thermal entropy support exact classical de Sitter symmetry, and what would an obstruction imply for recurrences and the duration of a de Sitter phase?

sources.title: Logarithmic corrections, entanglement entropy, and UV cutoffs in de Sitter spacetime

evidence.text: Can a conformal description of the cosmological horizon explain de Sitter entanglement entropy, its logarithmic corrections and UV regulator, and the proposed finite dimension of an observer's Hilbert space?

sources.title: De Sitter Holography: Fluctuations, Anomalous Symmetry, and Wormholes

evidence.text: Assuming finite-entropy static-patch holography, how should the GKS obstruction to exact de Sitter symmetry be interpreted, and can Boltzmann fluctuations and gravitational saddles explain an approximate symmetry without excluding eternal de Sitter space?

sources.title: De Sitter quantum breaking, swampland conjectures and thermal strings

evidence.text: Can thermal string calculations constrain de Sitter space above the string curvature scale? The source separates weak-coupling partition-function methods from the unknown gravitational dynamics needed to convert a density into a lifetime.

sources.title: Distance Conjecture and De-Sitter Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Does consistency of entanglement within a de Sitter observer's static patch restrict scalar and geometric displacement? The paper tests this question using DS/dS holography and an assumed Gibbons–Hawking entropy capacity.

sources.title: Islands in closed and open universes

evidence.text: How does positive or negative spatial curvature change the existence, size, and location of cosmological entanglement islands, when thermal radiation is purified by a reference spacetime?

sources.title: Algebras, regions, and observers.

evidence.text: Can the algebra accessible along an observer's timelike worldline replace region-based observable algebras when gravity makes regions fluctuate, and what does explicitly including an observer imply for de Sitter observables and entropy?

sources.title: Notes on de Sitter space and holography

evidence.text: What bulk–boundary dictionary could describe de Sitter space, and do boundary actions, reality conditions and static-patch thermality favor two entangled boundary theories?

sources.title: de Sitter Entanglement and Conformal Description of the Cosmological Horizon

evidence.text: Can the four-dimensional de Sitter horizon entropy be interpreted as entanglement between disconnected boundaries or bulk wedges, and can orbifold-induced two-dimensional defects support a conformal description reproducing the relevant entropy?

sources.title: Adventures in de Sitter space

evidence.text: What do semiclassical horizon thermodynamics, entropy bounds and Nariai instabilities imply for possible quantum descriptions of de Sitter space? This is a selective survey of results and open problems.

sources.title: Closed Universe, Quantum Entanglement and Observers

evidence.text: Can entanglement with an external non-gravitational system provide a physical observer and nontrivial observables in a spatially closed gravitational universe, and connect observer proposals to a state-induced graviton mass?

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Can entanglement entropy in DS/dS constrain the matter content of de Sitter quantum gravity? The thesis proposes such a criterion to investigate qualitative swampland claims within a specified holographic framework.

sources.title: Aspects of quantum gravity in de Sitter spaces

evidence.text: How might de Sitter holography be reconciled with finite-dimensional Hilbert-space proposals, and what do string embedding obstructions and horizon thermodynamics imply for these approaches?

sources.title: Les Houches lectures on de Sitter space

evidence.text: Review classical de Sitter geometry, free scalar quantum field theory, horizon temperature and entropy as background for de Sitter quantum gravity; explain the conformal asymptotic symmetry underlying the proposed dS/CFT correspondence and derive suitable metric falloffs.

sources.title: Information-theoretic constraints in quantum gravity and cosmology

evidence.text: Which information-theoretic entropy constraints survive quantum matter effects in semiclassical gravity, and how can entanglement and causality constrain holographic descriptions of de Sitter and closed cosmological spacetimes?

sources.title: Entropy, Entanglement and Swampland Bounds in DS/dS

evidence.text: How do the candidate entanglement entropies change when matter backreaction deforms the radial warp factor while preserving de Sitter slices and radial horizons?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: A finite inflationary episode provides an observable regulator of de Sitter space: modes leave the early Hubble horizon and can subsequently re-enter a decelerating universe. The relevant entropy changes with H and is evaluated at the end when bounding the total duration.

sources.title: Two-point correlators in de Sitter-prepared states with bra-ket wormholes

evidence.text: Can bra-ket wormholes modify scalar two-point functions in de Sitter-prepared states in ways qualitatively compatible with finite horizon entropy, late-time residual correlations and complementarity?

sources.title: Chaos and complementarity in de Sitter space

evidence.text: Do static-patch de Sitter OTOCs exhibit maximal chaos, and what do positive-energy shockwaves imply for observer complementarity and possible inflationary information exchange?

sources.title: The dS/dS correspondence

evidence.text: What holographic description captures a single observer’s de Sitter static patch, and how do gravity and brane probes encode its thermal field theory and horizon dynamics?

sources.title: Note on single-field inflation and the swampland criteria

evidence.text: Does subluminal scalar propagation alter the causal-region entropy argument used to motivate the refined de Sitter conjecture?

sources.title: A string theoretic derivation of gibbons-hawking entropy

evidence.text: Can open-string Chan–Paton species provide a microscopic account of Gibbons–Hawking entropy for a temporary de Sitter-like state, and explain its area scaling without constructing an eternal de Sitter vacuum?

sources.title: Quantum de Sitter horizon entropy from quasicanonical bulk, edge, sphere and topological string partition functions

evidence.text: How can exact quantum corrections to de Sitter horizon entropy be computed for general gravitational EFT spectra, organized into bulk and edge contributions, and used to constrain proposed microscopic entropies?

sources.title: Entanglement, Observers and Cosmology: a view from von Neumann Algebras

evidence.text: What physical information is carried by finite type II entanglement fluctuations obtained by adding a quantum observer/reference frame, when G_N=0 or N=∞? The applications concern inflationary scalar fluctuations and the high-temperature large-N Yang–Mills phase.

sources.title: De Sitter Musings

evidence.text: How should observables, horizon entropy and quantum gravity be formulated in asymptotically de Sitter space, distinguishing a static-patch observer from a metaobserver accessing future-boundary data?

destinations.title: Does an asymptotic bubble observer evade every finite-entropy observational restriction? The apparent infinity of collision observations exposes a gap between the demonstrated rolling-inflation bound and a proposed universal limit on information about de Sitter space.
Can finite de Sitter entropy constrain the number and range of inflationary flat directions, or the combination of many particle species and a high ultraviolet cutoff?
Can a horizon entropy bound for a single de Sitter observer be applied to global left/right entanglement on an entire spatial slice?

Why does localized structure require special initial conditions when empty de Sitter space has high entropy? The proposed answer assigns an entropy cost proportional to localized energy times horizon radius.
How can causal geometry encode the number of quantum states accessible to an observer? The entropy principle identifies a causal diamond's screen area with its quantum entropy capacity.

Can a semiclassical bulk protocol transfer information between antipodal de Sitter observers on a scrambling timescale while respecting complementarity and avoiding observable cloning, and what energy and information bounds constrain it?

Can Coleman–De Luccia transitions originating in de Sitter space, including transitions to a big crunch, admit a finite-entropy quantum interpretation consistent with unitarity and detailed balance? In particular, is the crunching region's maximal causal-diamond area finite?

When can radiation entropy outgrow horizon entropy in inflationary quasi-de Sitter space with increasing horizon size, and can an island resolve the resulting static-observer information paradox without strongly deforming the background?

What algebra describes observations in a gravitational de Sitter static patch, and can its entropy explain empty de Sitter space as a maximum-entropy state while reproducing semiclassical generalized entropy?
How do slow-roll horizon flux, its accumulated fluctuations, and the inflationary duration change a static observer's von Neumann algebra and its relation to generalized entropy?
Can global de Sitter spacetime and its Euclidean vacuum be represented through entanglement between two boundary CFTs, with a single static patch recovered by tracing over one copy?

Can two-dimensional supergravity with positive cosmological constant and linearly realised supersymmetry furnish controlled Euclidean dS2 path integrals, and can supersymmetric localization clarify their proposed horizon-entropy interpretation?

How can connectivity between antipodal de Sitter static patches emerge from horizon-screen entanglement, and how do quantum entropy corrections and inward screen displacement change reconstruction of the exterior?
Can pure dS3 Einstein quantum gravity admit a microscopic matrix-integral description that computes integrated cosmological correlators and accounts for cosmological-horizon entropy?

Can Lorentzian gravitational path integrals for states prepared by shells or end-of-the-world branes account for the entropy of states indistinguishable to a de Sitter observer, including in Schwarzschild–de Sitter?

Can de Sitter entropy and a small neutrino mass scale share a microscopic origin in gravitational topology, with orbifold-instanton moduli supplying holographic degrees of freedom and an information-based suppression of neutrino masses?
Can Euclidean de Sitter entropy be understood in string theory as the number of degrees of freedom of a dual quantum mechanics, using the sphere factors of AdS compactifications?

What asymptotic construction can characterize quantum gravity in de Sitter space, and what could finite entropy imply for quantization, the physical Hilbert space, and precisely calculable or measurable quantities?

Can an observer's four-dimensional de Sitter physics be described by horizon matrix degrees of freedom with finite entropy? The paper distinguishes entropy accounting from reproducing ordinary matter equations of motion and takes only a step toward the former criterion.

Can antipodal identification combined with charge conjugation implement observer complementarity in de Sitter space, support an observable S-matrix and single-boundary holography, and accommodate finite entropy with positive-norm states?

Can D-brane domain-wall deformations of de Sitter flux compactifications expose entropy-carrying degrees of freedom, satisfy covariant entropy bounds, and support an open-string interpretation of a de Sitter causal patch?

Can a root-of-unity quantum deformation extend finite-dimensional, unitary dS/CFT constructions to three-dimensional de Sitter space, regulate horizon entanglement entropy, and relate representation parameters to the cosmological constant?
